lines.text: Di María is back in the starting eleven for the final after an injury earlier in the tournament.
Di María scored the winning goal in last year's Copa América final against Brazil.
Lionel Messi from the spot, and scores! Argentina 1-0 France.
Messi was never going to miss from that distance.
Messi is 35, and has said this will be the last World Cup match of a remarkable career.

title: 36' Di María goal for Argentina (Argentina 2-0 France)

lines.text: France keep pushing attacks down the left side; that's where it's paying off for them.
Argentina break! Álvarez leads it.
Di María free on —
GOAL! Ángel Di María scores for Argentina, set up by Alexis MacAllister! Argentina 2-0 France.
Di María with a clinical finish. And what a precise ball from MacAllister.
MacAllister started it, then Messi and Álvarez carried it on.
Wow, huge space for Di María out wide. No one marked him at all.
Otamendi continues to be rock solid, not a misplaced pass from him tonight.
Kolo Muani scored within a minute of coming on in the semi-final.
GOAL! Kylian Mbappé converts the penalty. Argentina 2-1 France.
Mbappé was never going to miss from there.
Mbappé already has a World Cup winner's medal, at 23.
France are back in it. This game just changed.
Coman carries it on.
Coman, to Rabiot.
Mbappé, on the edge of the —
GOAL! Kylian Mbappé scores for France, set up by Marcus Thuram! Argentina 2-2 France.
Mbappé made that look easy, and it was anything but. And what a ball from Thuram.
Camavinga started it, then it went through Thuram and Rabiot.
Look at the space! Mbappé is completely free on the far side; nobody picked him up at all.

title: 105' Lautaro Martínez chance for Argentina, blocked (0.23 xG)

lines.text: The break came to nothing in the end.
MacAllister.
MacAllister.
Messi threads it through to MacAllister!
Martínez's shot is blocked.
Montiel shoots, but there's a body in the way.
Argentina keep winning possession high up the pitch.
Tchouaméni.
France are opting to clear long again. No interest in building from —
Argentina break! Martínez leads it.
Martínez shoots, —
GOAL! Lionel Messi scores for Argentina! Argentina 3-2 France.
Clinical finish from Messi there.
Montiel started it, then Martínez and Messi continued the move.
Messi had a penalty saved against Poland in the group stage, and has scored the others since.
Mbappé was only the second teenager to score in a World Cup final, after Pelé.
Mbappé continues to push forward with the ball for France.
Kylian Mbappé from the spot, and scores! Argentina 3-3 France.
Mbappé had that chance, and he wasn't going to miss it.
It's all square again, and the tension in the final is electric. Everything feels different now.

title: 120+3' Kolo Muani chance for France, saved by Emiliano Martínez (0.28 xG)

lines.text: Konaté threads it through to Kolo Muani!
Good stop from Martínez to deny Kolo Muani.
The goalkeeper is —
Fernandez threads it through to Messi!
Montiel.
